saints.name: Julian
saints.legacy: Patron of hospitals and the sick
saints.summary: Saint Julian, known as the Hospitaler, was a martyr who lived in Egypt during the early 4th century. Together with his wife, Basilissa, he dedicated his life to charity, converting their home into a hospital for the poor and sick. After enduring persecution for his faith, Julian was ultimately martyred in 313, and his tomb became a site of numerous miracles.
